Sandbox_Parkour_EnableWindowVault_toolti: Allows the custom two-part window vault after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableFallRollLanding_to: Allows Parkour_FallRollLanding after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableGetUpBack_tooltip: Allows Parkour_GetUpBack after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableBumpRecovery_toolt: Allows Parkour_BumpRecovery after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableVaultStumble_toolt: Allows Parkour_VaultStumble after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableProgression_toolti: When disabled, level requirements are bypassed. Physical restrictions and individual animation toggles still apply.
Sandbox_Parkour_UnlockAllParkour_tooltip: Debug-friendly override for level gates. The real Parkour level and mastery bonuses are not changed.
Sandbox_Parkour_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies XP awarded by Parkour actions in addition to the standard skill multiplier.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableAntiFarm_tooltip: Blocks repeat XP from the same obstacle until 30 seconds pass and the player moves at least 20 tiles away.
Sandbox_Parkour_WallRunUnlockLevel_toolt: Sets the Parkour level required for Wall Run. Set to 0 to unlock it immediately.
Sandbox_Parkour_UnlockWallRunAtLevel5_to: When enabled, Wall Run unlocks at Parkour level 5 instead of the configured standard level. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_Parkour_LoadRestrictionMode_tool: Controls optional early-level backpack restrictions. Actual overloading always blocks mod-owned Parkour mechanics; normal weight within maximum capacity is always allowed.
Sandbox_Parkour_InjuryRestrictionMode_to: Relevant blocks serious injuries to body parts needed by the move; Strict blocks any deep wound or fracture.
Sandbox_Parkour_MinimumEnduranceMultipli: Scales the minimum endurance required to begin Parkour actions.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableEnduranceCosts_too: Makes manual Parkour mechanics consume endurance after successful use.
Sandbox_Parkour_ActionCostMultiplier_too: Scales the endurance consumed by manual Parkour mechanics.
Sandbox_Parkour_DodgeCostLevel3_tooltip: Base Dodge endurance cost as a percentage at Parkour level 3.
Sandbox_Parkour_DodgeCostLevel10_tooltip: Dodge endurance cost as a percentage at Parkour level 10; intermediate levels are interpolated.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableFrontFlip_tooltip: Allows Parkour_FrontFlip to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableCorkscrewVault_too: Allows Parkour_CorkscrewVault to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDashVault_tooltip: Allows Parkour_DashVault to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDiveRoll_tooltip: Allows Parkour_DiveRoll to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableBackflipVault_tool: Allows Parkour_BackflipVault to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableSpeedVault_tooltip: Allows Parkour_SpeedVault to be selected for a successful sprint vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableVaultOver_tooltip: Allows Parkour_VaultOver to be selected for a successful sprint vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableReverseVault_toolt: Allows Parkour_ReverseVault to replace a successful low-fence climb performed without running or sprinting.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableHighFenceFrontFlip: Allows Parkour_HighFenceFrontFlip to be selected for a successful climb over a high fence. Failed and struggle climbs remain vanilla.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableHighFenceVault02_t: Allows Parkour_HighFenceVault02 to be selected for a successful climb over a high fence. Failed and struggle climbs remain vanilla.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableSprintWindowVault_: Automatically uses Parkour_SprintWindowVault when sprinting into an open or broken window, or an empty window frame.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableWallRunUp_tooltip: Allows players to use Parkour_WallRunUp to climb a full wall onto a clear roof one level above.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableFreeJump_tooltip: Allows the FreeJump action to clear low fences and ordinary obstacles, but never walls or tall fences.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeForwardRollFo: Allows Parkour_ForwardRollDodge to be selected for the forward dodge branch.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeCombatRollFor: Allows Parkour_CombatRollForward to be selected for forward and non-directional dodges.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeLowDiveForwar: Allows Parkour_LowDiveDodgeForward to be selected for forward and non-directional dodges.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeCorkscrewEvad: Allows Parkour_CorkscrewEvadeBack to be selected for the backward dodge branch.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeBackflipBack_: Allows Parkour_BackflipDodge to be selected for the backward dodge branch.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeSideFlipLeft_: Allows Parkour_SideFlipDodgeLeft to be selected for the left dodge branch.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableDodgeButterflyRigh: Allows Parkour_ButterflyDodgeRight to be selected for the right dodge branch.
Sandbox_Parkour_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes selected vault, dodge, jump, and traversal diagnostics to console.txt.
